name: recommendation
markdown: This patient has mild lower urinary tract symptoms (IPSS 9) with a normal PSA and benign digital rectal examination, and no red flag features are documented. Because symptoms have persisted for six months despite declining initial medical therapy, a **routine urology referral** is appropriate to discuss conservative management options and possible further investigation [RULE: R-LUTS-001]. The referral should be made within the routine pathway (up to 84 days). Safety-netting advice should be given to return urgently if haematuria, acute retention, or other concerning features develop.
